title: AppMaker — Business apps, built differently
excerpt: Build with AI. Refine with precision. Own what you create. An AI-first builder for structured business applications, now in public beta.
content_html:
Describe the business app you need. AI builds it on a ready-made platform with forms, data, users and logic already in place. Refine it in conversation or in the editor, and export it when you're ready.

  • Free development platform
  • $3 in AI credits to try Build mode
  • No credit card required
  1. 01Build with AI.Describe it in plain language.
  2. 02Refine with precision.In conversation, visually or in code.
  3. 03Own what you create.Export it and run it where you choose.

Start with AI. Take control whenever you want.

AppMaker is built for one kind of software: structured, data-driven business applications. That focus is what lets the AI move quickly and lets you stay in charge of the result.

AI-first building

Describe what you need in plain language. The AI builds it while you watch the running app, and you refine it conversationally.

Structured by design

Every app is made of the same parts: forms, data, server logic, users and roles. The AI fills in a known structure instead of inventing one.

Control when you need it

Switch from Build to Design and edit the forms, data and code the AI wrote. Nothing is regenerated, nothing is hidden from you.

Your app, your terms

Export a standalone Node.js application and run it on infrastructure you choose. Keep working in AppMaker, or carry on outside it.

Two ways to work on the same app.

Start in Build mode and let the AI do the heavy lifting. Open Design mode when you want to see exactly how something works, or change it yourself.

Build mode

Describe it. Watch it run.

Chat with the AI and try your app beside the conversation. You don't need to know about forms, schemas or scripts to get started.

  • Ask for new screens, data and rules in plain language.
  • Use the running app while the AI works on it.
  • See what changed after every task, and undo it if you don't like it.

Design mode

Open it up. Refine every detail.

Everything the AI created is there to inspect and edit: forms and controls, tables and SQL, client and server JavaScript, workflows and jobs.

  • Adjust layouts and properties visually.
  • Edit the code in a full editor with the API at hand.
  • Hand the next change back to the AI whenever you like.

Switch between them any time. Both modes work on the same project, so nothing is converted, regenerated or lost.

AI builds on a foundation, not from scratch.

Many AI tools generate the whole stack for every app: the data layer, the sign-in, the plumbing between them. AppMaker already has those parts. The AI spends its effort on what is specific to your app, inside a structure that stays the same from one project to the next.

  • Less to generate. The database, sign-in, users and roles, file storage, jobs and workflows are part of the platform.
  • A structure you can inspect. Changes land as named forms, scripts and tables you can open in Design mode, not as scattered files.
  • Every change is reviewable. Each AI task ends with a short report, a list of what changed, and Undo.
  • Consistency, not guarantees. AI can still make mistakes. Review and test what it builds, as you would any code.

How the platform works

Built for real business applications.

AppMaker is designed for structured, data-driven software. These are the kinds of applications it targets. They are starting points, not finished products.

  • Internal business tools

    Admin screens, lookups and the small tools every team ends up needing.

  • CRM and customer management

    Contacts, companies, deals and the history behind them.

  • Inventory management

    Stock, locations, movements and reorder levels.

  • Approval workflows

    Requests that move between people, with roles deciding who sees what.

  • Operational dashboards

    KPI cards, charts and top lists computed on the server.

  • Custom client applications

    The tailored app a client asks a consultant for, delivered faster.

Screencasts Three more apps built with the AI agent, each from a short description, and one built by hand in Design mode.

Free development platform. AI credits included. No subscription required.

Designing, coding and starting from templates are free. New accounts get $3 in AI credits to try Build mode, with no credit card.

Pricing details

Try Build mode on your own idea.

Describe a small business app and watch it take shape. No credit card required.
